map.不是。存栏是某一时点在栏数量；出栏是一定时期内达到上市规格卖出的总量。两者用于不: No. Inventory is the number in the barn at a point in time, while sales are the total sold at market weight over a period. The two serve different management and statistical purposes.
map.不能。密度过高增加呼吸道病、啄癖与氨味，还超出粪污处理能力。应参考品种饲养手册与: It cannot. Too high a density raises respiratory disease, feather pecking and ammonia levels, and exceeds manure handling capacity. Base it on the breed husbandry manual and the local environmental discharge limits.
map.养殖存栏量估算 使用指南: How to use the livestock inventory estimator
map.填写「年饲养批次数」。: Enter the "number of rearing batches per year".
map.存栏 = 养殖面积 × 饲养密度（头/㎡ 或 只/㎡）。: Inventory = rearing area × stocking density (heads/m2 or birds/m2).
map.存栏和出栏是一回事吗？: Are inventory and sales the same thing?
map.按动物福利与排污承载确定合理密度上限。: Set a reasonable density cap based on animal welfare and the waste carrying capacity.
map.播种日期计算器（基于无霜期）: Sowing date calculator (based on the frost-free period)
map.用于圈舍设计、粪污处理规模匹配。: Used for pen design and manure handling capacity matching.
map.由圈舍面积与单头占地面积得同时饲养头数（面积 ÷ 单头占地），再按饲养周期与年批: From the pen area and the area per head, get the number of head raised at once (area / area per head), then convert to the annual output using the rearing period and the number of batches: batches per year = 365 / rearing period × concurrent batches; total annual output = head per batch × batches per year. This supports planning farm capacity, feed purchasing and manure handling.
map.输入单栋圈舍面积、饲养密度与养殖周期，估算可承载存栏头数与全年出栏批次规模，辅助: Enter the area of one pen, the stocking density and the rearing period to estimate the head that can be carried and the annual batch output, supporting capacity planning, feed purchasing and manure handling decisions.
map.饲养密度能按经验随便定吗？: Can the stocking density just be set from experience?
map.：鸡舍实用面积 800 m²，推荐密度 10 只/m²（折合约 15 kg/m²: : with a usable broiler house area of 800 m² and a recommended density of 10 birds/m² (about 15 kg/m²), the inventory = 800 × 10 = 8000 birds. Raising the density to 12 birds/m² gives 9600 birds but requires rechecking ventilation and manure capacity.
